name: draft-a-lore
description: Offline-first writing app for manuscripts, story planning, and branching adventures, with work stored on the user's own device.
author: Daymien Vanhorn

scripts.sync-android: python3 build-mobile.py && npx cap sync android
scripts.build-android-debug: python3 build-mobile.py && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build-android-release: python3 build-mobile.py && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
